name: Cyan128-03, 2BDR
headline: Cordial 2 BDR w / Pool Access @ Cyan El Gouna
summary: This 2 bedroom apartment is located in Cyan El Gouna, sleeps 4 guests and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's Cyan community.

It features a spacious living room overlooking the lagoon, a walk in fully equipped kitchen, 2 full bathrooms and guest bathroom. 

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. 



At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire property
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood: - Just minutes from Abu Tig marina (features many restaurants, cafes and bars)
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee).
description.Notes: Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

location_address1: CM68+2G6, الجونة، الغردقة،،, Hurghada 2, Red Sea Governorate 1982710
agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Upon arrival we were informed that unfortunately the blinds of the front door/window were broken but someone would be coming to fix them immediately. No one came at all throughout our stay which meant we weren’t able to access the outside through this main door and the place was very dark with the blinds stuck closed. 

Additionally, there were hairs on the bed sheets and the towels were dirty which makes me wonder whether or not they were cleaned between guests. One of the bathroom floors also had a spill on it which was not clean. 

The property said they would provide a small cleaning fee refund $25 out of the +$300 that was paid, it’s been over a week and I have yet to see the money at all. Definitely not worth the value, very frustrating.

We stayed at this property for two nights and were initially excited given its great location and spacious layout. Unfortunately, it didn’t live up to expectations.

It’s a shame because the place has a lot of potential, but issues started upon arrival. Some AC remotes were missing, and another had dead batteries with no replacements. The living room shutters didn’t work, which felt unsafe as it allowed easy access from outside. Wi-Fi wasn’t available upon arrival, and we had to wait about two hours for it to be sorted.

There were also safety concerns — one bedroom window wouldn’t lock at all. On top of that, there was no hot water for the entire stay. Someone came to fix it and assured us it would work, but it never did.

Xuru Stays did try to help by offering to move us to another apartment and sending workers to fix the issues. However, since we were only there for two nights, relocating or staying while repairs were ongoing wasn’t practical.

Overall, quite disappointing.
Great stay and xuru stays are very responsive
